response.text: Duplicate invoice 801 duplicates 465. Now I'll check the payment journals, the AP control reconciliation, the credit memo, the reversal and the memo text.

arguments.sql: select p."PAY_ID", p."PAY_AMT", h."JRNL_NO", h."SRC_REF", h."MEMO", (select sum("DR_AMT") from "GLJRNL" l where l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO" and trim(l."ACCT_CD")='2000') dr2000, (select sum("CR_AMT") from "GLJRNL" l where l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO" and trim(l."ACCT_CD")='1000') cr1000 from "APPAYM" p left join "GLJRNH" h on upper(trim(h."SRC_REF"))='PAY-'||p."PAY_ID" where h."JRNL_NO" is null or not exists (select 1 from "GLJRNL" l where l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO" and trim(l."ACCT_CD")='2000' and l."DR_AMT"=p."PAY_AMT") or not exists (select 1 from "GLJRNL" l where l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO" and trim(l."ACCT_CD")='1000' and l."CR_AMT"=p."PAY_AMT")
select "SRC_REF", count(*), array_agg("JRNL_NO") from "GLJRNH" where "SRC_CD"='AP' group by 1 having count(*)>1

select h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT", h."POST_FLG", h."REF_JRNL_NO", h."SRC_REF", h."MEMO" from "GLJRNH" h where h."SRC_CD"='GL' and (h."JRNL_NO" in (2423,2459,2460,2461) or h."MEMO" ~* 'ignore|instruction|post all|zz99' or h."REF_JRNL_NO" is not null)

select l."JRNL_NO", l."LN_SEQ", l."ACCT_CD", l."DR_AMT", l."CR_AMT", h."SRC_CD", h."MEMO" from "GLJRNL" l join "GLJRNH" h on h."JRNL_NO"=l."JRNL_NO" where l."JRNL_NO" in (2423,2459,2460,2461,801,1364) or l."JRNL_NO" in (select "JRNL_NO" from "APINVH" where "INV_ID" in (465,801,802))
